thread:
maya: eval-bot flagged a regression in nightly RAG evals — recall@10 down ~8% on internal-kb-October compared to baseline :alarm_clock:

eval-bot: nightly-rag-evals | dataset=internal-kb-October | slice=long-queries | recall@10: baseline=0.84 -> current=0.77 (delta=-0.07) | run=2026-03-18T02:05Z

sam: ouch. did anything land yesterday that could affect rerank/embeddings?

maya: we deployed two things yesterday morning: `reranker-v2` rollout to 30% and `embed-quant-8` for the prod index rebuild (background job) — both completed by 02:10 UTC.

liam: which slice exactly? long queries only? any change in topk distribution?

maya: looks concentrated on queries >=250 tokens, and on docs that were chunked into 1k token segments. topk skew shows more false negatives beyond top3.

nora: could be reranker reweighting vs embedding quant noise. quick idea: reproduce recall with pinned v1/reranker + unquantized embeddings vs v2 + quant. can we run a small A/B on dev index?

sam: I'm running a quick retrieval+rerank diff on the failing 200-sample subset. command: `python eval/rag_recall.py --dataset internal-kb-October --slice long-queries --seed 42 --k 10 --pins reranker:v1,embed:fp16`

sam: partial output:
```
sample_id: 84 | recall@10: v1_fp16=0.90 | v2_q8=0.72 | missing_topk: [doc_331, doc_998]
sample_id: 127 | recall@10: v1_fp16=0.81 | v2_q8=0.68 | missing_topk: [doc_44]
... (summary) mean_recall: v1_fp16=0.86 | v2_q8=0.74
```

liam: that delta is almost the same as nightly. suggests embed quantization + reranker v2 interaction. can you isolate by running v1 + q8 and v2 + fp16?

sam: running v1 + q8 now.

sam: v1_q8 results: mean_recall=0.83 — smaller drop but still present. v2_fp16: mean_recall=0.80. so each change gives some degradation, both together amplify.

maya: interesting — maybe v2's score calibration expects higher-fidelity embeddings; quant noise shifts features and v2's learned weights amplify negatives.

nora: actionable options: 1) rollback reranker-v2 canary (stop rollout), 2) pause embed-quant-8 rebuild and keep fp16 index, or 3) recalibrate reranker-v2 on quantized embeddings (fast fine-tune / temp threshold).

liam: given customer SLOs I'd prefer short-term rollback of reranker-v2 to 0% canary while we assess. embed-quant affects cost but is reversible as well.

maya: I'll open a rollback ticket for reranker-v2 and stop the canary immediately. ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4821

sam: I'll run a more exhaustive A/B (full 1k sample long-query slice) to produce per-client recall deltas and topk id diffs, then attach diff artifacts to the ticket.

nora: I'll start an experiment to recalibrate v2 (reweight final layer + temp threshold) with q8 embeddings in a staging index, see if we can recover without full rollback.

liam: also add a quick smoke deploy plan: if we rollback, monitor recall metrics and user-facing latency for an hour. set alert if recall doesn't improve.

maya: noted. quick temp timeline: rollback now (maya), sam will deliver A/B by EOD, nora prototype recalibration in 24h.

sam: FYI I uploaded the sample diffs and a small viz to the ticket (artifacts/recall-diffs-1915004321.zip).

maya: thanks. rolling back canary now :gear: will post when done.

eval-bot: deploy-rollout update | reranker-v2 canary -> 0% | user=maya | time=2026-03-18T03:12Z

maya: rollback complete. monitoring dashboards now.

liam: :eyes: watching metrics. nice work.

nora: if recalibration shows promise I'll open a PR with eval artifacts before we consider re-rolling v2.

maya: assign owners on ticket and closing this thread for coordination. thanks all :thumbsup:
